prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Formalize Your Desktop Pet Adoption", "Give your new desktop companion an official name and sign the adoption certificate to finalize setup.", "Pet Name", "Official Pet Adoption Pledge"]
1: ["Preparing Your Pet's New Desktop Home", "Your pet is getting ready! Select initial personality traits while setup finishes in the background.", "Select starting traits: Playful, Quiet, Curious"]
2: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Right-click your pet to bring up actions, drag to move across monitors, or use hotkeys to hide.", "Release Pet to Desktop", "Quick Controls: Drag to move, right-click for menu, double click to interact.", "Test Controls Now"]
3: ["How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?", "Choose a fast pre-made companion or build a unique pet from scratch."]
4: ["Save & Protect Your Desktop Companion", "Sign in to safely bind your pet's traits and items to your profile so customization is never lost.", "Signing in ensures your pet stays saved even after app updates or restarts."]
5: ["What is Your Desktop Routine?", "Answer 2 quick questions to match with a companion optimized for your daily work focus.", "Find My Match", "Quiet Focus Mode vs Playful Alert Mode"]
6: ["You can minimize this window! We will alert you on desktop the moment your pet is ready."]
7: ["Tip: You can always control pet visibility and sound from the system tray icon in your taskbar."]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Bring warmth and helpful focus breaks to your daily workflow with an animated desktop pet.", "Choose My Companion"]
9: ["If the sign-in window does not load, tap below to reload the authentication screen.", "Reload Sign-In Window"]
